title: Right / left 11-11 (Matrix Profile)
summary: Same 11/11 recording as experiment 06 (right / left arm movements among natural ones). This experiment finds repeated stretches (motifs) and unusual ones (discords) in the continuous signal with the Matrix Profile. Truth (video times + Andrew's notes) is used only to evaluate.
result: With 4 s windows, when a movement's most similar stretch is another movement, it is of the same type in 8/9 cases (11/12 with 6 s windows)
method: Matrix Profile on the continuous signal (drift-free angles, 4 s windows): nearest-neighbour search for repeated stretches (motifs) and unusual ones (discords)
